check_na.name: semantic_dup
check_na.rationale: gate-sandboxed execution exceeds the 600s check timeout on this machine (12m13s in the parity venv, CPU-only torch); the same command passes manually with all ratchets within limits (duplicate_loc 6978 <= 7000), and semantic-dup-scan.yml runs authoritatively in CI. Owner directed to proceed past this local-only environment limitation.

directive_events.owner_directive: Precedence decision from owner: project > user > package > core (owner's UI per-target tier choice is deferred to follow-up issue 2049). User-tier discovery loads unconditionally like types; manifest defaults stay project-only. Previewers become the third consumer of core/dropins.py: scoped sys.path via prepended_sys_paths, collision guard generalized to previewer dirs, bytecode eviction, BaseException isolation, failures recorded on registry diagnostics; render-time lazy string providers re-activate previewer import roots like BlockRegistry.instantiate does. The live work-import brief template carried the same stale no-user-tier instruction and was re-transcribed per FR-026.
